_how_to_use: Copy this file to GTA_RADAR_RESULTS\REVIEWED_EVIDENCE.json and fill one entry per project. Every value below is an EXAMPLE placeholder, not a real finding. A project is only 'verified' when every field has a real https official page, a verbatim excerpt, and reviewer_confirmed set to true by a named person. Run: python reviewed_evidence.py --folder GTA_RADAR_RESULTS

reviews.project_id: EXAMPLE-ONLY: copy the project_id from COMMERCIAL_REVIEW.csv

project_source.excerpt: Verbatim text copied from the page that identifies the project.

project_identity.excerpt: Verbatim text linking this exact application or address to the project.

scope_evidence.excerpt: Verbatim text describing the construction or equipment scope.

buyer_org_evidence.excerpt: Verbatim text that names Example Company Ltd as owner or operator.

buying_authority_evidence.excerpt: Verbatim text showing Example Company Ltd owns and operates the site and funds the work.

contact_route_evidence.excerpt: Verbatim contact details published by the company for business enquiries.

procurement_evidence.excerpt: Verbatim text showing trade packages are not yet awarded, or an open tender notice.

source_first_publication.excerpt: Verbatim headline and publication date line from the page.
